items.title: Basic Attack as a normal At-will Action on PCs
items.do: Open Aveline's Actions tab and select Aveline's token to open the HUD.
items.expect: Basic Attack sits in the main At-will Actions section on Aveline's sheet (beside Drawing Light) and in the main Actions tab of the HUD, not in the Basic Actions grid/tab. Fists stays in Basic Actions.

items.title: Basic Attack Tier 1 1d4! and ! on weapon dice in roll dialog
items.do: With Aveline (Longsword) targeting the Orc Warrior, open Basic Attack. Check the roll dialog Tiers, force a Tier 1, and roll damage.
items.expect: Roll dialog Tiers show ! on all weapon dice (1d4! Slash on Tier 1, 1d4!+6 + 2 Slash on Tier 2, 1d6!+9 + 1d6! + 2 Slash on Tier 3). Tier 1 rolls an exploding 1d4! Slash.

items.title: Sworn Blade slides a Strained target on Basic Attack
items.do: Make the Orc Warrior Strained, then have Aveline use Basic Attack against it (try Tier 1 as well as Tier 2/3) and apply damage. Also test Aveline's Drawing Light (Tier 2 or 3) against a Bloodied Orc Warrior.
items.expect: Both chat cards show their Strained/Bloodied line on the attack card itself. Sworn Blade triggers on any landed Tier (including Tier 1) and offers Slide 1. Drawing Light against a Bloodied target prompts Slide vs. Pull (or Esc to skip).

items.title: Steady Draw adds +1[D] on Tier 3 against a pre-Strained target
items.do: Make the Orc Warrior Strained before rolling, then have Sylwen (Hunting Bow) target it with Basic Attack. Check the roll dialog notice and Tier 3 preview, force Tier 3, roll damage, and open both the dice breakdown and the = ledger. Repeat against a non-Strained Orc Warrior (and on Tier 2).
items.expect: The Steady Draw notice in the roll dialog is crisp/active (not faded) and Tier 3 preview includes the extra 1d4! Pierce. The attack card lists Steady Draw under Applied, the damage roll includes the extra 1d4! labeled Steady Draw in both the dice breakdown and the = ledger (with no bogus Flat -1 on exploded dice), and no extra [D] is added on Tier 2 or against a non-Strained target.
